adjudication.rationale: Looking at the Office365CalendarService.ts diff, the createEvent method extracts `[mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []` and uses `mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId` to determine the calendar URL. Unlike GoogleCalendarService which receives `credentialId` as a parameter and uses `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` to select the correct calendar per credential, Office365CalendarService always uses the first destination calendar. In a collective team event where multiple hosts have different Office 365 calendars, the EventManager calls createEvent for each credential, but Office365CalendarService will always write to the first host's calendar instead of matching the calendar to the credential being used.
